prompt.project_info: Create a polished historical-fantasy game character portrait of an adult fictional character inspired by the Three Kingdoms setting.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman in an ornate purple sheer dance-inspired dress with elaborate updo, floral and metallic hair ornaments, jewelry, and flowing translucent sleeves. She looks back with a charming but non-sexual smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Three-quarter over-shoulder portrait with the character turned toward camera, layered purple fabric and petals, glowing fantasy environment, and game-interface information panels along the left side. Preserve the vertical character-card hierarchy and existing Chinese typography/icons shown in the preview.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Purple-magenta cinematic fantasy light, soft rim light, luminous haze, ornate historical-game atmosphere, rich layered costume detail.
prompt.technical_specs: Vertical portrait, high-detail game key art, sharp face and costume, controlled translucent fabric, atmospheric depth, readable but coherent interface panels, no invented unrelated text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Historical-fantasy game character portrait of an adult fictional Diaochan-inspired woman in an ornate purple sheer dance dress, elaborate updo with floral and metallic hair ornaments, jewelry, and flowing translucent sleeves, looking back with a charming gentle smile. Three-quarter over-shoulder pose, layered purple fabric and petals, cinematic purple-magenta lighting, luminous haze, fantasy setting with game-interface information panels along the left side. Preserve the vertical character-card hierarchy, existing Chinese typography and icons, ornate costume detail, sharp face, atmospheric depth, and polished high-detail game key-art finish.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, sexualized pose, fetish framing, minor, real-person likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, blurry, low quality, distorted features, bad anatomy, extra limbs, extra fingers, deformed, illegible UI, random text, watermark

assets.name: adult fictional Diaochan-inspired character
assets.usage: Preserve fictional identity, face, hair ornaments, expression, and three-quarter pose; do not map to a real public figure.

assets.name: ornate purple fantasy dress
assets.usage: Keep purple palette, translucent sleeves, metallic details, and layered fabric consistent; replaceable with equivalent fantasy costume.

assets.name: historical-fantasy game UI panels
assets.usage: Preserve panel positions, icon hierarchy, and existing Chinese typography structure; replace text only while retaining role and legibility.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the matching preview to lock fictional character, costume, pose, and game-card UI. Preserve identity, outfit, palette, panels, and typography hierarchy. Do not introduce real-person likeness, unrelated logos, or extra text; replacement assets must remain fictional and equivalent.
